What we are building is fundamentally a game engine: characters, moves, a stage, a camera, a timeline, and, soon, mini games. It is a version of what I started in my book, mapping ideas to actions you can see. And it should be published like everything else, as a library with a latest version and pinned versions that never change, so any site, this newsroom included, can import it and tell a story without writing the engine again ([every tool its own website](../../every-tool-its-own-website.md)).
